feeds.title: Brendan Mac's Guitar Blog
feeds.description: Brendan Mac's Guitar Blog is a blog where you get to read about various types of guitars, guitar lessons for everyone, from beginners to an expert, detailed insights into various types of guitars, and more. Feel free to explore the blog and learn a thing or two.

feeds.title: ESP Guitars
feeds.description: ESP Company, Limited is a Japanese guitar manufacturer, primarily focused on the production of electric guitars and basses. They are one of the world's leading manufacturers of high-quality guitars and basses. ESP LTD is a great high-value guitar that is built for metal.

feeds.title: Tym Guitars Blog
feeds.description: Tym guitars have been an independent music retailer, distributor, repairer, and manufacturer in Brisbane, Australia since 1997. They also do some limited guitar repair, restoration, refinishing, and setup work. Their blog has an extensive catalog of information about vintage guitars, effects, and amps as well as repairs and restorations.

feeds.title: Australian Guitar Review
feeds.description: Australian Guitar Review aims at providing quality news, reviews, and information to Australian and International guitar players. The site was developed due to a limited amount of information on the Australian guitar market. This site is totally independent of any retailer or brand and therefore we report the news as we see it. Reviews on products are on the majority purchased by Australian Guitar Review at full retail price with no special 'back door' deals.

feeds.title: Steve Flack Guitar Academy Blog
feeds.description: Want to learn to play guitar the right way once and for all? I'm Steve Flack, a qualified guitar teacher, a passionate musician, the owner of the Liverpool Academy of Music, and the founder of the band Steve Flack's Guitar Heroes. With a little hard work and dedication, he can help you turn your guitar dreams into a reality.

feeds.title: Salvi's Fine Guitars Blog
feeds.description: Steve Salvi welcomes visitors to his website, showcasing his over 35 years of passionate advocacy for the guitar, its players, and its music. He loves nothing more than being around guitars and guitar players, and feels privileged to have reached his current position. He eagerly anticipates meeting many more players in the years to come. Steve's blog is dedicated to guitar repairs, restoration, and custom building, all of which take place in Adelaide, South Australia.

feeds.title: Guitar Gear Finder
feeds.description: Aaron Matthies is a guitar teacher residing in Australia who has a strong passion for the guitar. His website serves as a platform for him to help other guitar enthusiasts out there. His blog contains a wealth of information on guitar lessons, guides, gear reviews, and more, catering to guitarists of all levels of proficiency. His primary objective with this website is to offer top-notch advice and guidance to anyone interested in learning the guitar or enhancing their knowledge of it.

feeds.title: Rock Guitar Lessons Blog
feeds.description: Dean Luke is a professional guitar teacher from Melbourne whose lessons focus exclusively on rock, blues, and metal styles. Specializing in lead guitar, Dean has had the pleasure of helping hundreds of students from all over Australia improve their guitar playing, overcome their challenges, and develop the playing ability they've always wanted.

feeds.title: I heart Guitar Blog
feeds.description: In 2008, the creator of I Heart Guitar began the blog as a means of preserving their articles from print magazines that lacked websites. The goal was to establish a fun and engaging platform for guitar enthusiasts to come together and geek out over all things related to guitars. The blog features articles on guitars, interviews, and a plethora of informative content.a of informative content.

feeds.title: Alien Guitar Secrets Blog
feeds.description: Whether you consider yourself to be a complete beginner, or intermediate, or even if you are already a proficient guitar player constantly learning new concepts, I am here and at your service. My lessons are super informative, structured and fun, designed to awaken (or re-awaken) your musical senses, helping to unlock and unleash the virtuoso in you.

feeds.title: Fret Dojo Blog
feeds.description: Introducing Greg O'Rourke, a pro jazz guitarist based in Australia. His website is dedicated to providing essential concepts and techniques to aspiring jazz guitarists, allowing them to approach their craft with confidence. The goal is to offer step-by-step jazz guitar lessons that provide shortcuts to mastering key skills needed to become an exceptional jazz musician, even for those with limited time.
